test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The list price of an article is Rs. 850. It is sold for Rs. 528.87, after giving three successive discounts of 20%, 15% and x% on the list price. What is the value of x ?
solution:
Given:

Marked price = Rs. 850.

Selling price = Rs. 528.87, after giving three successive discounts of 20%, 15% and x% on Marked price.

Concept used:

Marked price is also called List price.

Selling price = Marked Price - Marked Price × Discount%

Final discount percentage after two successive discounts of A% and B% = (A + B - {AB over 100})\%
